{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts lag behind price turning points, showing delayed reaction to momentum shifts.",
    "Sentiment features amplify model predictions when market sentiment is positive, creating upside bias.",
    "When sentiment turns negative, model predictions undershoot true prices due to delayed fear-based selling.",
    "Mean reversion effect causes model forecasts to converge toward current prices as volatility decreases.",
    "Price volatility clusters in the model's forecast horizon, causing systematic overshooting of volatile periods.",
    "Sentiment momentum (changing sentiment) predicts forecast corrections better than static sentiment values.",
    "Model systematically under-forecasts price lows and over-forecasts price highs by 0.3-0.7 price units"
] }
